title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省巴拉桑市镇阿兰胡埃斯描笼涯阿兰胡埃斯小学的名称变更为Pedro Bedez小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Aranjuez Elementary School in Barangay Aranjuez, Municipality of Balasan, Province of Iloilo, to Pedro Bedez Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Aranjuez Elementary School in Barangay Aranjuez, Municipality of Balasan, Province of Iloilo, to Pedro Bedez Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7222_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Aranjuez Elementary School in Barangay Aranjuez, Municipality of Balasan, Province of Iloilo, is hereby changed to Pedro Bedez Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
